description: Every positive real number has exactly two distinct real square roots: for \(x>0\), there are \(y\ne z\) such that \(t^2=x\iff t=y\text{ or }t=z\) for every real \(t\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.RealMaps.positive_has_two_square_roots (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
  ∃ y z, y ≠ z ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ), t ^ 2 = x ↔ t = y ∨ t = z
